content.text: The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-2|digital]] product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for payments, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-guide-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-7|Crypto Payment]] payment is a critical [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] component for digital creators in regions with restricted payment access. It's not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that empowers creators to take control of their online stores, data, and revenue. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can break free from platform fees and monetize their digital products with complete ownership and control.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments integrates with this stack to verify automatic on-chain crypto payments, converting USD prices at transaction time. This architecture ensures seamless, fee-free delivery of digital products to customers worldwide.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in regions with restricted payment access, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines. These creators can now sell digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and plugins without relying on Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Lemon Squeezy. By choosing a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can escape platform fees, maintain data ownership, and scale their businesses more efficiently.
By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can save thousands of dollars in fees and maintain complete ownership and control of their online stores and data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. They can then follow a step-by-step checklist to deploy their stack, configure NOWPayments, and set up automatic crypto payment verification. With this knowledge, creators can break free from platform fees, monetize their digital products with complete ownership and control, and scale their businesses more efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
NOWPayments offers the lowest fees and most seamless integration with this architecture.

If you're looking for a way to sell digital downloads without platform fees, you're in the right place. This infrastructure is also relevant to related searches like 'sell ebook without paypal stripe gumroad sovereign stack' and 'digital download store crypto only no platform.' With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can deploy a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment verification and instant product delivery.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, follow these steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197), deploy your GitHub Pages site, configure NOWPayments, set up automatic crypto payment verification, and start selling your digital products. Next, create a Cloudflare Workers script to handle backend logic, configure Supabase for order storage, and set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments with your stack and start receiving payments in USD converted at transaction time. By following this checklist, you can break free from platform fees and monetize your digital products with complete ownership and control.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between NOWPayments and Gumroad?

NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5% fee, while Gumroad charges 10% on every sale. By choosing NOWPayments, creators can save thousands of dollars in fees and maintain complete ownership and control of their online stores and data.
Can I use this infrastructure with other payment gateways?
Yes, you can integrate other payment gateways with your sovereign digital commerce stack, but NOWPayments offers the lowest fees and most seamless integration with this architecture.
What if I have existing customers on Gumroad or PayPal?

You can migrate your customers to your new sovereign digital commerce stack, but be sure to communicate the benefits of this infrastructure to your customers and provide clear instructions on how to access their digital products.
How do I configure Supabase for order storage?

To configure Supabase for order storage, follow the instructions in the Complete Builder Kit documentation and set up a new database instance. Then, integrate Supabase with your Cloudflare Workers script to handle order storage and retrieval.
Can I use this infrastructure for physical products?
No, this infrastructure is designed for digital products only, such as ebooks, courses, templates, and plugins. For physical products, you'll need to use a different infrastructure solution.
